simple.summary: גֵּישָׁן (Gêyshân) means Geshan , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 47.

definitions.full: H1529. Geshan גֵּישָׁן proper name, masculine a descendant of Judah through Caleb 1Chr 2:47 . גֹּל גֵּל, גַּל, see below גלל גלב ( = shear, shave , Assyrian [ galâbu ] Hpt SFG ; Aramaic גְּלַב id. , גְּלָב razor ; compare 2Sam 20:8 see PS).
